files.data: {"before": "3c8a134a14d45813a5796eccb5df56445b02a6d0a681f22018357ae2836c2e5e", "after": "72e5e27218ab31909319757c1afb237ad67368a4fa552fed2d105887e40b7ca5", "replacements": {"Design every connection for water.": "Oil and water play by different rules. Good engineering respects the difference.", "Purpose-built water hydraulics uses materials, wear surfaces and seals selected for water. Apply the same attention to the small connections as to the pump and actuator.": "Oil and water can both transmit hydraulic power, but a system designed for oil cannot simply be expected to run reliably on water. Water demands a different approach to lubrication, wear and, especially, material compatibility.", "Carry the material review through valves, fittings and connections. Select each alloy and polymer for its role, the working water and the other materials it contacts.": "That is why material selection must extend through the entire water circuit. A carefully engineered pump is only part of the solution: the valves, fittings and connections must also be compatible with the water and with one another. Our approach centres on 316 stainless steel and carbon-reinforced PEEK, with materials selected for their role and operating conditions.", "WQS Stainless supports that approach with stainless fittings and connection hardware for a coordinated equipment scope.": "That principle is why we created WQS Stainless: to supply the 316 stainless steel components that help carry sound engineering through every part of a water hydraulic system. Because reliable water hydraulics begins with designing for water from the start.", "Bring the hydraulic equipment and connection requirements to one discussion. We’ll help define a coordinated supply package with clear materials, interfaces and responsibilities.": "Our WQS Stainless division makes it possible to offer complete turnkey water hydraulic systems from a single manufacturer. From the hydraulic equipment to the stainless steel fittings and connections, you benefit from a coordinated package, consistent material selection and one point of contact for the complete system."}}
